fixed.explanation: filterCookies prefixed a dot to every cookie domain, so host-only cookies matched subdomains. It also used a plain string prefix for paths. pathMatches in cookieStore appended a slash to the request path, so /foo matched /foo/. I changed both to follow RFC 6265 5.1.3 and 5.1.4. I inlined the checks in network.ts to avoid a possible circular import.

input.intent: Cookie URL filtering helper (filterCookies) that prefixes a dot to every cookie domain and compares paths by string prefix; plus the cookie matching used when sending (domain match and path match in cookie store) that appends a slash to the request path. Fix to follow RFC 6265 domain-match (host-only exact) and path-match (exact or slash boundary).
input.symptom: Listing cookies for URLs returns host-only cookies for subdomains and prefix-path cookies like /apiv2, and a cookie with path /foo/ is sent to /foo.
